author: neal_illustrator
title: Looking for artists for comic and animation teams
content: Heyo! I’m doing an all call looking for artists to help build out my comic and animation teams! I think it’s time to try and ease up some of the stress and expand my team! I’m excited to see y’all’s portfolios! Application Links are in my linktree (in bio)

author: harrier_studio
title: Harrier Studio is hiring illustrators and comic artists
content: HARRIER STUDIO IS HIRING! OPEN POSITIONS: Illustrator (Full Stage), Sketch Artist (Drafter), Line Artist, Colorist, Compositor, Storyboard Artist, Styling Artist, Typesetter. Send CV & Portfolio to: harrierstdrecruitment@gmail.com (Subject: Nama – Posisi – CV & Portofolio). Open until positions filled.

author: kisai_ent
title: Kisai hiring sketch and finishing artists
content: Kisai sedang mencari: Business Development Officer (KY Academy), Business Development Officer (Original IP), Sketch Artist (Western Style), Sketch Artist (Action or Romance), Finishing Artist. Apply at kisaient.com/careers. Applications only accepted through the official Kisai Entertainment website. DM for questions.

author: willai3213
title: Seeking graphic/character designer for Taipei exhibition
content: 【徵｜展覽平面設計專案合作 】近期正在籌備一場預計於 12月初在台北華山 舉辦的展覽，想尋找一位有興趣合作的平面設計師。預計設計內容含主視覺、標準字、角色視覺設計（共 6 款）、角色立牌等。希望手繪、日式、溫暖風格。有興趣請留言或私訊，附上作品集＋報價。
